verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents a dedicated headless mode: `--prompt`/`-p` runs a single task and exits, prompts can be piped via stdin, JSON output is available, timeout exit codes and approval policies are configurable, threads can be resumed, and `runMC` is safe to embed in CI scripts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of headless runs in real scripts.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent non-interactively in scripts for workflow automation

citations.quote: Pass `--prompt` (or `-p`) to run a single task and exit:
Prompts can also be piped via stdin by passing `-` as the prompt:
`runMC` never calls `process.exit` and never writes to global streams, so it is safe to embed in CI scripts and servers.
A single final JSON object (text, usage, tool calls/results, threadId, status)
Exit with code 2 if not complete within the timeout
`auto` (default) approves everything; `deny` refuses approvals and aborts on suspension
